_comment: Generic profile shim (any language) — composes universal gates: github-fast-checks (Tier 1, dev/feature pushes ~18s universal) + github-release-heavy (Tier 3, prod pushes/tags deterministic). Pure composition recipe — ships NO workflow file of its own; exactly one workflow per tier exists in gated repos.
name: github-ci-security-generic
description: Universal fallback gate via universal tiers: fast-checks (dev/feature pushes, ~18s) + release-heavy (prod pushes/tags). Composition recipe only — no extra workflow file.

variables.name: license_denylist
variables.description: Comma-separated license IDs that block deployment

variables.name: prod_branches
variables.description: Comma-separated production-level branch names (T3 push trigger; T1 excludes them)

variables.name: staging_branch
variables.description: Staging-level branch name (T2 push trigger; T1 excludes it)

notes: Shim composing universal tiers: Tier 1 github-fast-checks (universal ~18s, any stack) + Tier 3 github-release-heavy (deterministic prod/tags). Ships no workflow file of its own — a future dedicated SAST tier would be authored as its own template. Docs-only skips.
